question: What are the scriptural endpoints?
premises: Ending at Sadāśiva in left-right scriptures.
Ending at Samanā in Mata Yāmala.
inference: Different scriptures have different endpoints: vidyā-kalā, Sadāśiva, or Samanā.
plain_english: In Siddhānta it ends at vidyā-kalā; in left-right scriptures at Sadāśiva; in Mata Yāmala at Samanā.
